title: Mandatory Submission of Anti-Ragging & Demographic Undertakings
author: Dr. Avneesh Vashistha (Chief Proctor)
content: As per UGC and Supreme Court of India statutory directives, all newly enrolled 1st-year students must upload their online Anti-Ragging affidavit reference number through the Student Registration Dossier before October 10, 2026.

title: Digital IEEE Xplore & ACM Digital Library Research Access
author: Central Library Committee
content: All enrolled undergraduate and postgraduate students have been granted institutional remote access to IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, and ACM Digital Library. Access credentials can be activated using student institutional emails.

title: Annual National Hackathon & Innovation Conclave 'CodeCraft 2026'
author: Dr. Anjali Sharma (Faculty Coordinator)
content: The Department of Computer Science & Engineering is thrilled to announce 'CodeCraft 2026' — 36-Hour National Inter-College Hackathon on AI & Decentralized Systems with a total prize pool of ₹3,00,000. Registrations open on the portal.

title: Campus Hostel Outpass & Gate Pass Protocol Update
author: Hostel Warden Committee
content: All hostellers must submit digital outpass applications at least 6 hours prior to departure via the Student Portal. Biometric check-in before 08:30 PM is mandatory on all weekdays.
